name: bitchat-desktop
description: Additive Windows desktop gateway for the BitChat portable web core.

scripts.prepare:runtime: npm --prefix ../../web-preview run build && node scripts/prepare-runtime.mjs && node scripts/prepare-native-radio.mjs
scripts.package:windows: npm run prepare:runtime && npm run package:windows:prepared
scripts.package:windows:prepared: electron-packager . bitchat-desktop --platform=win32 --arch=x64 --out=dist --overwrite --prune=true --win32metadata.CompanyName="BitChat Community Contributors" --win32metadata.ProductName="BitChat Desktop Community Preview" --win32metadata.FileDescription="Unofficial experimental BitChat client for Windows" --extra-resource=runtime/native-windows --extra-resource=runtime/web-preview --ignore=^/dist --ignore=^/tests --ignore=^/scripts --ignore=^/native-windows --ignore=^/installer\.iss$ --ignore=^/runtime/native-windows --ignore=^/runtime/web-preview
